QuestionStmt.S: Identify the name of reaction when phenol reacts with chloroform in aqueous NaOH.

Solution.S:
When phenol reacts with chloroform (CHCl₃) in aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH), the reaction is called the Reimer‑Tiemann reaction.

In this reaction, an aldehyde group (—CHO) is introduced mainly at the ortho position of phenol, forming salicylaldehyde.

C₆H₅OH + CHCl₃ + NaOH → o‑HO–C₆H₄–CHO

So, the correct option is Option B: Reimer-Tiemann reaction.
